name: Ljutyj Ded i Kollektorskoe Agentstvo
source: A very old man, having lost all his property to debt collectors and forgotten by his relatives and society, one unremarkable day loses consciousness and wakes up in Sovyonok to have a truly remarkable adventure.
translation: 一位年迈的老人，所有财产都被追债人夺走了，并被亲戚和社会遗忘，在一个平凡的日子里失去了知觉，在索维诺克醒来，开始了一场真正非凡的冒​​险。
